payload.purpose_context: The current app shows a character's inventory as a flat read-only list and gifts as raw legacy strings. The legacy monolith has a categorized slot-grid backpack, typed weapon/armor stats, and a rich gift-detail modal whose data was never persisted. This mission migrates all of that onto typed, persisted Firestore data — the prerequisite for the upcoming Vitruve interactive character sheet.
payload.purpose_tldr: Port the legacy categorized inventory (10 slot-capped backpack categories, typed weapons/armor) and enriched dons (gifts) with detail modal into the Vue app.

payload.wp_title: Data layer: types, parser, persistence, fixtures
